import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final boolean DEBUG = false;
    static final long INFFLUJO = (long) 1e14;
    static final long INFCOSTO = (long) 1e14;
    static final int MAXN = 50 * 100 + 15;
    static final int SRC = MAXN - 1;
    static final int SNC = MAXN - 2;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        long cost;

        public Edge(int u, int v, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }

        long rem() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static int nodes = MAXN;
    static List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] dist = new long[MAXN];
    static long mncost;
    static int[] pre = new int[MAXN];
    static long[] cap = new long[MAXN];
    static long mxflow;
    static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        if (DEBUG) {
            String dem = Integer.toString(u);
            String pen = Integer.toString(v);
            if (u == SRC) dem = "SRC";
            if (u == SNC) dem = "SINC";
            if (v == SRC) pen = "SRC";
            if (v == SNC) pen = "SINC";
            System.out.println("add edge: " + dem + " " + pen + " " + cap + " " + cost);
        }
        g[u].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
        g[v].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void flow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        mxflow = 0;
        mncost = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INFCOSTO);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            pre[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(cap, 0);
            cap[s] = INFFLUJO;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            in_queue[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                in_queue[u] = false;
                for (int i : g[u]) {
                    Edge E = e.get(i);
                    if (E.rem() > 0 && dist[E.v] > dist[u] + E.cost + 1e-9) {
                        dist[E.v] = dist[u] + E.cost;
                        pre[E.v] = i;
                        cap[E.v] = Math.min(cap[u], E.rem());
                        if (!in_queue[E.v]) {
                            q.offer(E.v);
                            in_queue[E.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[t] < 0) break;
            mxflow += cap[t];
            mncost += cap[t] * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = e.get(pre[v]).u) {
                e.get(pre[v]).flow += cap[t];
                e.get(pre[v] ^ 1).flow -= cap[t];
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int MAXT = n + k;
        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("MAXT: " + MAXT);
        int[] a = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            add_edge(SRC, a[i] * MAXT, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < MAXT; j++) {
            add_edge(j, SNC, k, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    add_edge(x * MAXT + j, y * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    add_edge(y * MAXT + j, x * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    add_edge(i * MAXT + j, i * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c);
                }
            }
        }
        flow(SRC, SNC);
        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("mncost: " + mncost + " mxflow: " + mxflow);
        System.out.println(mncost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
